title: Labor Rights & Employment
description: Quiz on labor protections, workplace standards, and employment regulations in Nepal.

questions.question: Which principle underpins fair labor standards?
questions.explanation: Decent work encapsulates fair wages, safety, and dignity.

questions.question: Select protections typically included in labor rights.
questions.explanation: Labor rights include safety, unions, and bargaining; forced unpaid overtime violates standards.

questions.question: True or False: Minimum wage policies help mitigate in-work poverty.
questions.explanation: Minimum wages set a floor that can reduce extreme low pay.

questions.question: Which factor strengthens enforcement of labor rights?
questions.explanation: Transparent monitoring and penalties improve compliance.

questions.question: Which situation signifies disguised employment?
options: Independent label but controlled hours & tools
questions.explanation: Control without formal employment suggests misclassification.

questions.question: Which is a gender equity measure in workplaces?
questions.explanation: Equal pay audits detect and reduce unjustified gaps.

questions.question: Which indicator best evaluates decent work progress?
questions.explanation: Injury rates show workplace safety performance.
